model.structure: pace ~ N(1.06, 0.13) USD bn/q for 3Q26 and 4Q26 -> remaining at 5 Nov (~$2.3bn, 2.2 quarters of pace) and at Feb (~$1.28bn, 1.25 quarters); November hazard 0.12 fixed (judgement: the reading sits in the never-observed 1.6-2.7 quarters-of-pace gap but inside the observed $1.5bn-yes / $2.5bn-no band on dollars; logistic interpolations 0.17-0.18, dollar-threshold 0.13, pace-threshold 0.30, auditor cap 0.08); February trigger = 50/50 blend of the MLE logistic on the 16-print panel (k 1.423, r50 1.075; 3 events, not identified on episodes) and the revision-1 hand-set rule (k 2.0, r50 1.45) -> P(announce Feb | not Nov) 0.52, P(by Feb) 0.58; size >= $5bn 0.75 (regime judgement: last two programs 1.33-1.58x FCF; historical frequency 2 of 4 = 0.50); leg B hazard 0.06 (0.14 after a November authorization), simulated Q4 tested at $1.45bn (letters round to $0.1bn); union 0.469, shaded to 0.46 toward the frequency base rate.

impact.note: Immaterial. A renewal of the $6bn program at the existing pace is the modal outcome and is already in the FY27 share count (595.8m -> 573.0m); authorizations are announced only inside the letter and the four day-0 CARs (+5.2, +2.2, +0.2, -1.0%) are confounded with the print (09_stock-behaviour-and-alpha.md lines 21/186/305; 09_event_study_events.csv). Stock +$1.0 at the existing pace, +$2.5 for a >= $1.5bn Q4 pace signal, weighted by P(leg B | Yes) 0.152 = +$1.23; FY27 EPS +$0.027 on leg B only, weighted $0.004 -> 0.00. The memo's 'floor on sell-offs, not a catalyst' line stands; the record shows no opportunistic step-up after sell-offs (3Q25 $857M letter / $877M cash after -8.0%; 1Q26 $1.1bn after -6.2%).
